hooks.text: 成功任务可献给不同神系换取祝福，并结合神圣遗物塑造重装粉碎或坚守坦克等流派
hooks.excerpt: Dedicate your successful quests to the Pantheon and gain their blessings. Gather various divine relics and tap their powers. Do you want to be a Sanctified Juggernaut, smashing evil into fragments? An Unyielding Stalwart, watching while wicked washes off your proud armor? The choice is yours.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 堡垒守军不仅亲自近战，还要布置陷阱、炮塔与路障并指挥强壮团员迎击军队
hooks.excerpt: Hold fast against the armies brought to bear against the Paladin Order's Fort. However, wielding a fast blade will not be enough to prevail. Utilize traps, turrets and barricades devised by the clever members of your Order, while the stronger members will follow your orders on the battlefield.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 深入火山口时可招募、营救或说服拥有关键技能的人才，为新生骑士团补齐能力
hooks.excerpt: As Titus and his Order venture deeper into the Crater, there are opportunities to add valuable skills to the fledgling Order. Recruit, rescue or persuade those whose skills may give the Order another edge against evil.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
